FINAL ZONINGLOTDEVELOPMENTAGREEMENT BETWEEN LA PAZ FUNERAL SERVICES,INC. AND LAALTAGRACIAFUNERALHOMEINC. COUNTYOFBRONX BLOCK 2331 LOTS 13 AND 71 RECORDANDRETURN TO: GOLDMANHARRISLLC 475Park Avenue South,28th Floor New York, NY 10016 Attention: Eric J. Vath, Esq.

ZONINGLOTDEVELOPMENTAGREEMENT into as of the LSday of September, 2023, by LA PAZ FUNERAL SERVICES, INC, a New York corporation having an address at 285 E. 149th Street, Bronx, NY 10451 ("Lot 71 Owner") and LA ALTA GRACIA FUNERAL HOME INC., a New York corporation having an address at c/oElaine Marquez,10181 Spring Shores Drive,Winter Garden,FL 34787(the“Lot 13 Owner"). WITNESSETH: WHEREAS, Lot 13 Owner is the fee owner of certain land, with the buildings and improvements thereon, located in the Borough and County of the Bronx, City and State of New York, known as Lot 13 in Block 2331 on the Tax Map of the City of New York, County of the Bronx (the “Tax Map"), and as and by the street addresses 290 East 150th Street, Bronx, New York, and more particularly described in Exhibit “A” annexed hereto and made a part hereof (the “Lot13Land"); WHEREAS, Lot 71 Owner is the fee owner of certain land, with the buildings and improvements thereon, located in the Borough and County of the Bronx,City and State of New York, known as Lot 71 in Block 2331 on the Tax, and as and by the street addresses 285 East 149th Street, Bronx, New York, and more particularly described in Exhibit “B” annexed hereto and made a part hereof (the“Lot 71 Land"; the building located thereon together with any additions thereto or future alterations thereto or replacements, repairs or rebuilding thereof not prohibited by the provisions of this Agreement, are herein collectively referred to as the “Lot 71 Building"; and the Lot 71 Land and the Lot 71 Building are herein collectively referred to as the “Lot 71 Parcel"); WHEREAS, Lot 13 Owner intends to convey the Lot 13 Land with the Subject Development Rights (as hereinafter defined) to allow the development of a new building on all or a portion of Lot 13 Land and other improvements associated with such new building (the new building and improvements together with any additions thereto or future alterations thereto or replacements, repairs or rebuilding thereof not prohibited by the provisions of this Agreement, are herein collectively referred to as the “Lot 13 Building"); the Lot 13 Land and the Lot 13 Building are herein collectively referred to as the “Lot 13 Parcel"); WHEREAS, the Lot 71 Building contains less floor area, as defined in the Zoning Resolution (as hereinafter defined), than is now available for use on the Lot 71 Parcel pursuant to the Zoning Resolution, so that the Subject Development Rights (as hereinafter defined) are availablefor allocation and utilization on the Lot 13Parcel; WHEREAS,simultaneouslyherewiththeparties areexecutingaDeclaration of Zoning Lot Restrictions (the “Declaration"), a copy of which is annexed hereto as Exhibit “C", in accordance with certain provisions set forth in a definition of the term “zoning lot” in Section 12-10 of the Zoning Resolution, stating that Lot 13 Land and Lot 71 Land are a single zoning lot (the“Merged Zoning Lot");
